**Important Notices**

**URGENT MEDICAL DEVICE REMOVAL: Accu-Chek Guide Meters**

Important information on Accu-Chek Guide meters: Nine Accu-ChekGuide meters were configured
incorrectly, and thus show the results in mmol/L rather than in the labeled measuring unit, mg/dL.
Please check your meter to see if the display shows the appropriate measuring unit (mg/dL) and
compare the serial number of your meter with the listed affected serial numbers to determine if it
is impacted by this issue: 92339920445, 92339955415, 92340116052, 92340117408, 92340120006,
92340120057, 92339920116, 92339094787 & 92339744998. If your serial number is listed, discontinue
use of the meter and follow instructions in the file linked below.

**Important Notices**

**URGENT MEDICAL DEVICE REMOVAL: Accu-Chek Guide Meters**

Important information on Accu-Chek Guide meters: Nine Accu-ChekGuide meters were configured
incorrectly, and thus show the results in mmol/L rather than in the labeled measuring unit, mg/dL.
Please check your meter to see if the display shows the appropriate measuring unit (mg/dL) and
compare the serial number of your meter with the listed affected serial numbers to determine if it
is impacted by this issue: 92339920445, 92339955415, 92340116052, 92340117408, 92340120006,
92340120057, 92339920116, 92339094787 & 92339744998. If your serial number is listed, discontinue
use of the meter and follow instructions in the file linked below.

## Relentless innovation from the leaders in glucose health 

Dexcom has set the standard in glucose biosensing for 25 years and counting. Our best-in-class
technologies empower people to know what is happening in their bodies in real time, helping them to
better understand the many factors that impact their glucose and overall health.
Smart devices sold separately.^{‡}
* [Explore our portfolio][5]
[two people smiling in the park one wearing the Dexcom G7 sensor]
[Dexcom G7 sensor]

## Dexcom G7 and Dexcom G7 15 Day—the world's most powerful CGM systems²

Dexcom G7 CGM Systems deliver proven results^{3-7} with best-in-class accuracy² and a growing
ecosystem of connected partners that help ease the burden of living with diabetes. They’re designed
for all types of diabetes, sending glucose numbers to your phone^{*} or receiver in real time,
giving you the knowledge to better control diabetes for healthier tomorrows.^{8,9}
* [Explore Dexcom G7][6]
[Man walking outside while wearing Stelo sensor]
[Stelo sensor]

## Stelo Glucose Biosensor

Get 24/7 insights into how food, exercise, stress, and sleep affect your body, so you can build
habits that power lasting health.^{10,11}
No prescription. FSA/HSA eligible.
* [Learn more][7]
[Woman walking with a friend outside while wearing sensor]

## Empowering people to take control of health 

Since 1999, Dexcom has been developing innovative technology that has transformed how people manage
diabetes and track their glucose. We think of ourselves as partners in their journey, empowering
them to live confidently and take control of their health with our life-changing products.
* [More about Dexcom][8]


### Get Started with Dexcom

Take the first step towards better health! Glucose health is a critical part of overall health, and
Dexcom has the best sensing solution for you or your loved one regardless of your health goals.
We'll make getting started easy from the comfort of your home.
*For Stelo app compatibility information, visit [stelo.com/compatibility][9]. For Dexcom G7
compatible devices, visit dexcom.com/compatibility.

Guide. 11 Crawford M, et al. Diabetes. 2025;74(Supp 1):2020–LB.
BRIEF SAFETY STATEMENT: Failure to use the Dexcom Continuous Glucose Monitoring System and its
components according to the instructions for use provided with your device and available at
[https://www.dexcom.com/safety-information][10] and to properly consider all indications,
contraindications, warnings, precautions, and cautions in those instructions for use may result in
you missing a severe hypoglycemia (low blood glucose) or hyperglycemia (high blood glucose)
occurrence and/or making a treatment decision that may result in injury. If your glucose alerts and
readings from the Dexcom CGM do not match symptoms, use a blood glucose meter to make diabetes
treatment decisions. Seek medical advice and attention when appropriate, including for any medical
emergency.
STELO IMPORTANT INFORMATION: Consult your healthcare provider before making any medication
adjustments based on your sensor readings and do not take any other medical action based on your

    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.

    cancer and specialty care.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## In the spotlight

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

[How we improved outcomes for patients around the world][104]

With our combined strengths in Diagnostic and Pharmaceuticals, we worked to provide real and
positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

## Our mission in action

[
[Two colleagues sit on a green couch in a modern office, engaged in conversation. One person
gestures while speaking, and the other listens attentively with a slight smile.]
Prevent

### Identifying high-risk patients

We prevent diseases by identifying high-risk patients early to enable timely use of medicines.

Our strategy
][110]
[
[A laboratory scientist wearing safety glasses and gloves looks into a microscope while conducting
research in a lab setting.]
Stop

### Halting disease progression

We stop disease progression by accurately diagnosing patients and delivering targeted medicines.

Our diagnostics solutions

[
[A laboratory professional wearing glasses and gloves explains a piece of equipment to a colleague
while holding its open lid in a lab setting.]
Cure

### Restoring health through medicines

We cure diseases by identifying the cause of a patient’s condition and restoring health through
curative medicines.

Our pharma solutions

## APPLIED DSP AND VLSI RESEARCH GROUP

## Where Research Meets Industry!

[ADVRG wordcloud]
[Microbial Fuel Cell, Volkan Turgul]
ABOUT

## ABOUT

Within the Department of Engineering the Applied DSP and VLSI Research Group (ADVRG) was established
in the late eighties and has a long standing industry facing applied research and development track
record for systems and sub-systems that found and continues to find use in cutting edge commercial
products in the Communications, Electronics, Positioning (GNSS), Space (satellite payloads) and
Biomedical non-invasive diagnosis instrumentation sectors, having innovative, competitive,
complexity reduced, low-power custom/FPGA integrated, as well as board level and software, analogue,
RF, digital and mixed signal solutions, for clients from the UK, Europe, USA, Canada and Japan,
enjoying worldwide leadership and recognition in the design implementation and delivery of state of
the art solutions for real-life problems and products.

The group acts as a focus for research and industrial interaction, with signal processing, and
embedded custom as well as FPGA based analogue/digital solutions being the core activities that
support the application areas above. The group’s work has traditionally been supported and funded by
Industrial research and development contracts as well as National Research Council, European
Research Agency, and European Space Agency projects.

1989

## EXPERTISE

### Research Areas
* Digital Signal Processing (DSP)
  * Novel DSP algorithms
  * Machine Learning

* Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI)
  * Custom processor design
  * FPGAs
  * Low-power digital/analogue processor/processing system design

* Radio Frequency (RF)
  * Application-specific RF design
  * Full 3D EM simulations
  * Prototyping, testing and characterisation

* Analog and Digital Circuit Design

* Mechanical CAD
  * 3D printing
  * CO2 Laser cutting

### Applications
* Biomedical Instrumentation
  * Non-invasive diagnostics
  * AI-aided diagnostics

* Positioning Systems (GNSS)

* Satellite Systems

* Communication Systems

* Remote Sensor Networks

* Energy Harvesting

## APPLIED DSP AND VLSI RESEARCH GROUP

## Where Research Meets Industry!

[ADVRG wordcloud]
[Microbial Fuel Cell, Volkan Turgul]
ABOUT

## ABOUT

Within the Department of Engineering the Applied DSP and VLSI Research Group (ADVRG) was established
in the late eighties and has a long standing industry facing applied research and development track
record for systems and sub-systems that found and continues to find use in cutting edge commercial
products in the Communications, Electronics, Positioning (GNSS), Space (satellite payloads) and
Biomedical non-invasive diagnosis instrumentation sectors, having innovative, competitive,
complexity reduced, low-power custom/FPGA integrated, as well as board level and software, analogue,
RF, digital and mixed signal solutions, for clients from the UK, Europe, USA, Canada and Japan,
enjoying worldwide leadership and recognition in the design implementation and delivery of state of
the art solutions for real-life problems and products.

The group acts as a focus for research and industrial interaction, with signal processing, and
embedded custom as well as FPGA based analogue/digital solutions being the core activities that
support the application areas above. The group’s work has traditionally been supported and funded by
Industrial research and development contracts as well as National Research Council, European
Research Agency, and European Space Agency projects.

* Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI)
  * Custom processor design
  * FPGAs
  * Low-power digital/analogue processor/processing system design

* Radio Frequency (RF)

  * Full 3D EM simulations
  * Prototyping, testing and characterisation

* Analog and Digital Circuit Design

* Mechanical CAD
  * 3D printing
  * CO2 Laser cutting

### Applications
* Biomedical Instrumentation
  * Non-invasive diagnostics
  * AI-aided diagnostics

* Positioning Systems (GNSS)

* Satellite Systems

* Communication Systems

* Remote Sensor Networks

* Energy Harvesting

continuous, pain-free and real-time solution for individuals with diabetes and those at risk.
Glucowear addresses the critical challenges with the current monitoring landscape, empowering people
with diabetes to better manage their condition.

Afon is making significant progress as we enter clinical trials ahead of our anticipated launch in

# ALLPCB Offers Fast, Reliable PCB Manufacturing and Assembly Services for Your Projects.

## PCB Assembly Service

Support Rigid and Flexible PCB with SMT, THT, and Mixed Assembly.

### Advanced Capabilities
* Siemens & GKG machine fit 01005 parts within 0.03mm accuracy
* 20+ SMT lines support prototypes to mass production
* Support SPI, AOI, X-Ray, IC programming, functional test

[Quote Now][67]

### Strong Supply Chain
* Reduce BOM costs by 15-30% through bulk purchasing
* Original manufacturers and authorized distributors to ensure quality
* Co-located PCB and PCBA factories boost efficiency

[Learn More][68]

### Fast and Reliable
* Free DFM check and 24H customer support
* Full-process system monitoring ensure on-time delivery
* Quick after-sales response and solution in 2 days

[Learn More][69]

## PCB Prototyping and Manufacturing
* Basic PCBs
* Full-Featured

* From $5 /5pcs
* Layer count: 1-32 layers
* Turn time: from 24 hours

* Min trace/spacing: 3/3 mil

[Quote Now][70]

* Turn time: from 24 hours

[Quote Now][71]

* Turn time: from 3 days
* Support PI, FR4, Alu sheet stiffeners
* Support PCB Assembly

[Quote Now][72]

### HDI
* From $265/ 5pcs
* Layer: 4-20 layers
* Buried/blind vias
* Turn time: from 10 days

[Quote Now][73]

### Rogers

* RO4003C and RO4350B available

[Quote Now][74]

* Copper: 1-2oz

[Quote Now][75]

# Easy guidance for managing your diabetes

CONTOUR^{®}PLUS ELITE blood glucose monitoring system. Discover high accuracy* and ease of use – the
features you want from a meter.

[ Learn more ][19]

## CONTOUR^{®} Evolving with you

Explore our wide range of CONTOUR^{®} diabetes solutions for Blood Glucose Monitoring.

[CONTOUR PLUS ELITE device in hand]

## Highly accurate^{*}

Trust the highly accurate CONTOUR^{®} system to help you make better self-management decisions.

[Blood glucose meter showing smartLIGHT]

## smartLIGHT^{®}

Easily interpret blood glucose readings that identify if the reading is within your target
range.^{*}

[Close-up photo of CONTOUR PLUS strip]

## Save on Strips

Discover the Second-Chance^{®} sampling feature which may help you save test strips.^{*}

[Smartphone screen showing CONTOUR DIABETES app icon]

## Try our free app

The free CONTOUR^{®}DIABETES app supports diabetes self-management, adding meaning to the results.

^{*}References can be found on the CONTOUR^{®}PLUS ELITE product page.

[CONTOUR PLUS ELITE blood glucose meter]

## CONTOUR^{®}PLUS ELITE

CONTOUR^{®}PLUS ELITE blood glucose monitoring system. Discover high accuracy^{*} and ease of use –
the features you want from a meter.

[ Learn more ][20] [ Shop now ][21]

^{*}References can be found on the product page.

[CONTOUR PLUS strip package]

## CONTOUR^{®}PLUS Strips

Highly accurate and with Second-Chance^{®} Sampling technology to save on test strips.

[ Learn more ][22] [ Shop now ][23]

^{*}References can be found on the product page.

[Smartphone screen showing CONTOUR DIABETES app in use]

## CONTOUR^{®}DIABETES app

Managing diabetes, smarter. Test, track and share results more easily to gain a better understanding
of your blood glucose patterns.^{*}

[ Learn more ][24]

^{*}References can be found on the product page.

## The CONTOUR^{®}DIABETES app is available to support diabetes self-management, adding insight and
## meaning to the results.

Connect your meter with the CONTOUR^{®}DIABETES app for a seamless experience.

 

[ [Download on the App Store] ][25] [ [Get it on Google Play]

][26]

## Learn more about diabetes

Here, you can learn more about the right lifestyle choices, medication, and monitoring techniques to
keep your blood sugar levels in check. With regular check-ups, balanced nutrition, and physical
activity, you can take control of your health and prevent complications.

[Learn more][27]
[

Type 1 Diabetes

][28] [

Type 2 Diabetes

][29] [

Gestational Diabetes

][30]

## We're here to help

From FAQs to product manuals, explore our online support resources to find the information you need,
whenever you need it.

[ Support options ][31]
[Customer support agents]

## Ascensia Diabetes Care is dedicated to improving the health and lives of people with diabetes

Our goal is to provide products and solutions that make a positive, daily difference for people with
diabetes. We want to make sure diabetes doesn’t get in the way of people’s future, enabling them to
live richer lives.

[ Learn more ][32]
[Ascensia Logo]

[Shop Now][33]

[ [Ascensia Logo] ][34]
India

Type your country

Type to search countries. Use the up and down arrow keys to navigate results and press Enter to
select a country.

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]
[ Sign Up Now ][103]
[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.

[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]
[ Sign Up Now ][103]
[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.

[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

glucose monitoring. Our current focus is on developing a fully implantable system intended to
improve glycemic monitoring for people living with diabetes.

[About Us][19]

## ****Rethinking glucose monitoring****

Our early stage research is focused on a system that aims to reduce the burden of daily management
by eliminating external wearables and measuring glucose directly from the blood.

[CBGM Technology][20]

technologies designed to improve accuracy, convenience, and independence for people living with
diabetes.

Our long-term implantable Continuous Blood Glucose Monitoring (CBGM) technology is gearing up to be
a game-changer, unobtrusively integrating into everyday life. 

[CBGM Technology][22]

Glucotrack’s implantable CBGM is an investigational device and has not been approved by the FDA.

areas of diabetes, Obesity and Metabolic syndrome. 

The Iranian Journal of Diabetes and Obesity is published quarterly and all articles are

* Original articles in basic, clinical and applied research

# International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET)

**It is an international peer-reviewed, open-access and multidisciplinary online journal published
for the enhancement of research in various disciplines of Applied Science & Engineering
Technologies.**

**

We publish original and high-quality research papers. IJRASET has many benefits all geared toward
strengthening research skills and advancing academic careers. Journal publications are a vital part
of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

**Frequency:** 12 Issues per year (Monthly)

**Subject Categories:** Applied Science & Engineering Technology
* Open Access Peer-Reviewed Journal- No Subscription to access papers
* Best International Journal for Research Publication, Best Journal in India
* Fast Track Paper Publication Journal with a smooth and transparent process
* Indexed with Crossref for DOI & DOI for each Published Research Paper
* Indexed with [Google Scholar][81], [Academia.edu][82], [Issuu][83], [Scribd][84], Research Gate
* Best Academic Journal with major indexing that helps to increase citations
* Best International Journal for Paper Publication- Certified Journal
* Support and Guidance for students in regards to preparing & publish research papers
* Impact Factor- ISRAJIF and SJIF, Zero Tolerance Policy against Plagiarism, Referred by
  Indianscience.in

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

measure a wide range of organic and inorganic materials, molecules, and compositions of matter.

### Form Factor Agnostic

A technology platform that can be integrated into a variety of wearable, mobile or bench-top form
factors.

### 100+ Diagnostic Applications

Has the potential to identify and measure different molecules in and out of the the body, such as
glucose, oxygen, alcohol, metabolized drugs, and further industrial applications.

### Pain- & Waste-Free

No needles nor invasive transmitters in your body. Expensive supplies, such as test strips and
lancets, are not required. 

### Affordable

María
[María]
Every parent needs peace of mind. See how LinX supports María Isabel's family.

My name is Graciela Bocchi, and I have been living with type 1 diabetes for almost three decades—29
years, to be exact. It began during the pregnancy and birth of my fourth child, when I developed
gestational diabetes. At that time, this technology did not exist, and I had to rely entirely on a
traditional blood glucose meter, which some families who do not have access to continuous glucose
monitoring still depend on today.

What has LinX meant to me? It has brought great peace of mind to me, my family, and my husband. They
know that when I travel and stay alone in a hotel, I am protected because I can take preventive
action and avoid hypoglycemia—the greatest fear for all of us living with type 1 diabetes.

Today, LinX also enables both my doctor and me to make well-informed decisions. Any adjustment she
makes to my treatment during each consultation is based on data rather than perception. This
provides greater certainty in diagnosis and treatment, as well as safety and peace of mind.

It has also brought great psychological reassurance to the wider community I currently support as a
volunteer leader at Fundación Diabetes Latam, where I help facilitate access to sensors. People
living with diabetes, their children, and their parents can all feel happier and more at ease.

Thank you very much, LinX.

My name is Graciela Bocchi, and I have been living with type 1 diabetes for almost three decades—29
years, to be exact. It began during the pregnancy and birth of my fourth child, when I developed
gestational diabetes. At that time, this technology did not exist, and I had to rely entirely on a
traditional blood glucose meter, which some families who do not have access to continuous glucose
monitoring still depend on today.

What has LinX meant to me? It has brought great peace of mind to me, my family, and my husband. They
know that when I travel and stay alone in a hotel, I am protected because I can take preventive
action and avoid hypoglycemia—the greatest fear for all of us living with type 1 diabetes.

Today, LinX also enables both my doctor and me to make well-informed decisions. Any adjustment she
makes to my treatment during each consultation is based on data rather than perception. This
provides greater certainty in diagnosis and treatment, as well as safety and peace of mind.

It has also brought great psychological reassurance to the wider community I currently support as a
volunteer leader at Fundación Diabetes Latam, where I help facilitate access to sensors. People
living with diabetes, their children, and their parents can all feel happier and more at ease.

Thank you very much, LinX.

Back

Hello, how are you? My name is Francisco Filos. I have been living with diabetes since I was 16
years old. I am currently 23, so I have been living with type 1 diabetes for seven years.

LinX has made an incredible impact on my life, because I know that not only I, but many other people
as well, do not like needles or having to prick our fingers up to seven times a day just to know
what our glucose level is.

By using the LinX sensor, I can monitor my glucose on my phone whenever I need to, without having to
keep pricking my fingers. I can view my history, monitor my range, understand which foods cause my
glucose to rise, and which foods help keep it stable. That is how LinX has helped me.

I would like to encourage everyone not to see the condition as something negative, but as a
motivation in life. If you can manage your condition, you can achieve anything you set your mind to.

Thank God I was able to understand this and become stronger. I would also like to express my respect
and admiration for everyone living with a condition like this, because it is not easy, and what we
do every day deserves great respect and admiration.

Back

Hello, my name is María Isabel, and I am the mother of Isabel Victoria Souza. Isabel Victoria is my
little girl, my nine-year-old daughter, who has been living with type 1 diabetes for almost four
years. She was diagnosed when she was five.

Isabel is a child who loves to play, run around, and jump, just like any other child her age.
However, because of her condition and the decisions we have had to make while managing it, she has
had to mature quite a lot. Through it all, as her parents, our goal has always been to give her as
much comfort and security as possible throughout every stage of this journey.

For us, LinX is like a guardian available 24/7, constantly providing us with Victoria’s glucose
readings. It allows us to make immediate decisions in the event of hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia.

Type 1 diabetes is not an easy condition, but with education, we can do everything humanly possible
to help our children stay healthy.

It is a constant learning process. We must speak up for our children’s rights, ensure that they have
a supportive community, access to all the supplies they need, and proper education so that they can
learn how to manage their condition and better control type 1 diabetes.

LinX gives us a great sense of security.

No fear tactics. No food shaming. Just clear, doctor-reviewed guidance for living well with diabetes
or prediabetes — written by people who understand it’s a daily life, not just a diagnosis.

Where to start

# Your Trusted Source for Honest Reviews on Trending Products

We all know how tempting it is to buy something after seeing a viral ad on TikTok or Instagram. The
product looks amazing, everyone’s talking about it, and it seems like it’s exactly what you need.
But we’ve all been there: you order it, wait excitedly for it to arrive, and then… disappointment
sets in. The product doesn’t work, doesn’t look like the ad, or just doesn’t live up to the hype.

That’s where we come in. At SnoopViews, we’re here to help you cut through all the noise and find
out what actually works. We test products from TikTok, Instagram, Amazon, and beyond—giving you
**honest, no-BS reviews** so you don’t have to waste your time or money on stuff that doesn’t
deliver.

## **So, What Are Product Scams?**

Product scams are those items that promise the world but don’t actually do much. Maybe they look
amazing in the ads, but once you try them, they’re disappointing. It could be a beauty product that
does nothing, or a gadget that doesn’t work as advertised. These scams take advantage of flashy
marketing, misleading claims, and fake reviews to make you believe you’re getting something
special—only to end up feeling ripped off.

## **How We Help You Avoid Product Scams**

We’re all about **real, long-term testing**. Here’s what we do differently:
1. **Honest Reviews** – We don’t just do a quick unboxing and call it a day. We use products for
   weeks or even months, so you get the full picture. If something works, we’ll tell you. If it
   doesn’t, we’ll tell you that too.
2. **No Sponsorships, No Bias** – We don’t accept sponsorships from the products we review, so you
   can trust that our opinions are totally unbiased. Our goal is to help you make smarter choices,
   not push sales.
3. **Alternatives to Save You Time** – Sometimes, the product doesn’t cut it. When that happens,
   we’ll recommend better alternatives that actually do what they promise. No more falling for the
   same old tricks!

## **Why Are Product Scams So Common?**

It’s easier than ever for products to go viral online. TikTok and Instagram ads make it simple to
show off the latest products, often with before-and-after results that look too good to be true. But
the reality is, **not everything that’s trending is worth your time or money**.

Scammers love to use:
* **Exaggerated promises**: “Get professional results for just $20!” But it doesn’t live up to the
  hype.
* **Fake before-and-after images**: It might look amazing in the ad, but when you try it yourself,
  you’re left disappointed.
* **Limited-time offers**: “Only 5 left, order now!” is a classic way to get you to buy something
  impulsively.

## **How to Protect Yourself from Product Scams**

Here’s the thing: we all love a good deal, but not every bargain is worth it. Here’s how you can
avoid being scammed:
* **Research before you buy**: Don’t rely only on ads. Look for independent reviews and feedback
  from real people.
* **Watch out for red flags**: Bad grammar, sketchy websites, and overly dramatic claims are all
  warning signs.
* **Trust your gut**: If the deal sounds too good to be true, it probably is. Remember, quality
  products don’t always come with huge discounts.
* **Look for guarantees**: If a company doesn’t offer returns or a warranty, that’s a big red flag.

## **Join Us in the Fight Against Product Scams**

We’ve got your back. If you’re tired of falling for viral products that don’t deliver, we’re here to
help. We test out products, share the truth about what works (and what doesn’t), and provide you
with the most honest reviews possible.

Have a product you’re curious about? Let us know! We’re always testing new things and sharing our
real-life results so you can make the best choices.

Let’s stop falling for the scams together and start making smarter purchases.

## Empowering Healthcare with Strategic Solutions

Access complete healthcare market research, with detailed analysis and insights to empower

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
